_about: Every fixture the factory's parsers are tested against (factory-runtime spec section 12), with the migration step that captures it. Save-Fixtures.ps1 writes <name>.json here. Fixtures.Tests.ps1 checks that each one present matches its pin and is redacted, and that only those whose step is 18 or 'when one happens' may stay missing once the migration is done. README.md lists the ones still to capture.
